name: find-precedent
description: Search for earlier decisions and verdicts on a topic before proposing anything new: a log of declined ideas, the accepted-decisions folder, written rules, then a semantic search. Use before proposing a new field, script, structure, rule or automation, and whenever someone says "we discussed this before". Triggers: "have we decided this already", "was there a precedent", "what did we decide about", "did we reject this", "prior decision", "/find-precedent".
